plugins.//: granularPermissions is empty on purpose. The plugin declares READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO and READ_MEDIA_AUDIO by default, which are broad library reads, and Play asks an app that holds them to justify frequent access to photos. This app never reads the library: it writes one file to it, and it picks one photo through the system picker. READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED and the pre-33 storage permissions stay, which is all a write and a single pick need.
plugins.photosPermission: Hide The Notch saves the wallpapers it generates to your photos.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Hide The Notch saves the wallpapers it generates to your photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Choose a photo to turn into a wallpaper.

plugins.//: iOS gets the real thing: the app's own aurora gradient, full bleed, so the launch screen and the first frame are the same picture. Android 12 and later will not have that, the system draws a colour and a masked icon and nothing else, so there it is the average of that gradient with the marks on top.

Source map upload at build time, and nothing else. It needs SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN in the environment; without one the build still succeeds and the traces arrive minified, which is most of their value gone. The DSN is not here: it is in index.ts, because it is the only part the running app needs and it is public by design.
